battle_logic.description: Runtime-proven battle behavior and substitution settings.

glyphs.description: Use the English glyph atlas, packed metrics, and renderer geometry.

layout.description: Apply English text measurement, fitting, wrapping, selected styling, and screen-specific layout.

numeric_formatting.description: Format dynamic numbers with the English renderer conventions.

ui_layout.description: Apply English UI rectangles, anchors, scaling, and screen-specific geometry.

regional_input.description: Apply regional confirm, cancel, navigation, and related menu-input behavior consistently across the game.

startup.description: Independent startup-sequence skips and a timed loading counter during the boot loader wait.

loading_screen_then_main_menu.description: Skip the four splash screens and opening, preserve required startup loading, bypass the title, and enter the native Continue path; the retained confirmation loads the first save on Yes or enters the main menu without loading on No.

loading_screen.description: Replace the boot splashes with a large primitive percentage and progress bar paced across the measured 25-second load while the original startup loaders run.

command_display_off_by_default.description: Start Practice with command display disabled.

remove_adventure.description: Omit Adventure from Mode Select using the NUN6 negative availability sentinel.

remove_shop.description: Omit Shop from Mode Select using the same negative availability sentinel as the Adventure omission.

display_only_first_save.description: Select record zero directly in Save and Load flows while retaining the native memory-card scan, confirmation, load/save operations, and non-record status handling; No completes without reopening the removed record list.

native_16_9_horizontal_scale.description: Force the renderer's horizontal-scale field to 0.75 through its object pointer.
